intro.title: Language Skills
paragraphs: Your dream is to become a successful entrepreneur and create a business that brings people together.

You have just been hired by a large multinational company, where people from different cultures, backgrounds, and professions work together. Working at this company is a learning experience for you, as by completing various challenges within it, you will acquire skills included in the POMEIL Competency Map, which are essential for every entrepreneur.

Your first task takes you to the R&D waiting area, where you'll meet new colleagues from different countries. Strong communication skills will help you bridge any language barrier and build lasting professional relationships.

dialogues.greet: Hello! Welcome to the R&D waiting area. Our teams work with partners from all over the world, so strong Language Skills are essential. They help you communicate clearly, improve your career opportunities, and grow professionally.
dialogues.findTablet: Before you enter the R&D department, it's important to understand the four basic components of language proficiency. I left a digital tablet on the shared desk here with an interactive guide. Can you find it?
dialogues.tabletFound: Well done! Speaking and listening are crucial during meetings and discussions, while reading and writing are essential for reports, emails, and documentation in R&D.
dialogues.quiz1Intro: Let's test your understanding of these concepts.
dialogues.quiz1Done: Now that you understand the basics, let's talk about how to develop these skills. This is especially important when working in a demanding environment like R&D.
dialogues.findFlipchart: There are common challenges, such as lack of motivation or limited time. I wrote some solutions on the flipchart here after our last staff seminar. Go take a look.
dialogues.flipchartFound: Excellent. Clear goals and smart use of technology make language learning manageable, even with a busy R&D schedule.
dialogues.puzzle2Intro: Now, complete these final tasks to finish your training.
dialogues.finalWords:
Fantastic! You understand how to develop language skills in real work situations. Strong communication makes you more confident and effective.

Remember, language skills allow you to participate fully in international projects and the global labor market. Good luck!
dialogues.completion: Congratulations, you've completed everything and leveled up your Language Skills. Click the open door to exit.
dialogues.default: Keep looking around the waiting room for clues.

dialogues.busy: I'm preparing for my R&D presentation. Using digital tools really helps with pronunciation and confidence!

singleChoice.title: Overcoming Language Barriers
singleChoice.question: You are struggling to find time to practice a new language and feel unmotivated. According to the training, what is a good solution?

options.a: Stop learning until you have a full free day.
options.b: Leverage technology (digital tools) and join online communities.
options.c: Only use formal education methods like expensive seminars.
options.d: Avoid speaking until you are perfect.

singleChoice.hint: Think about modern tools. What can you use on the go to make learning personalized and social?

feedback.wrong: Think about modern tools. What can you use on the go to make learning personalized and social?
feedback.correct: Correct! Technology and online communities make language learning accessible and social.

singleChoice.answerOverlay: The correct answer is: Leverage technology (digital tools) and join online communities.

sequenceOrder.title: The Role-Play Exercise
sequenceOrder.instructions: You are participating in a language workshop. Arrange the steps of the scenario-based role-play exercise in the correct order.
items: Participants choose one situation and present their opinions.
Write common workplace situations (e.g., presenting an opinion) on paper.
All participants interact and discuss the subject further.
correctOrder: Write common workplace situations (e.g., presenting an opinion) on paper.
Participants choose one situation and present their opinions.
All participants interact and discuss the subject further.
hints: First, write down possible workplace situations. Then, decide which scenario you will focus on. After that, present it and finally discuss it together.

feedback.wrong: First, write down possible workplace situations. Then, decide which scenario you will focus on. After that, present it and finally discuss it together.
feedback.correct: Excellent! You arranged the role-play steps correctly.

sequenceOrder.answerOverlay:
The correct order is:
1. Identify the scenario.
2. Write common workplace situations on paper.
3. Participants choose one situation and present their opinions.
4. All participants interact and discuss the subject further.

popupContent: Speaking: Using language to express ideas, feelings, and opinions.
Listening: A receptive skill used to correctly interpret spoken messages.
Reading: Decoding and understanding written text.
Writing: A productive skill used to communicate through text.
Challenge: Improving skills without a certain goal.
Solution: Set clear goals—purpose increases motivation.
Challenge: Inconsistent motivation and lack of time.
Solution: Leverage technology and participate in online learning communities.
